name.label: Lib name, dash-case (e.g. design-system); the lib is libs/web/shared/<name>

prefix.label: Angular selector prefix, lowercase letters (e.g. ds): components are <prefix>-name, directives [prefixName]

description: New web lib shared by every context: libs/web/shared/<name> (alias @anvil/web-shared-<name>, tags scope:web, context:shared, type:ui) with the same project.json, eslint and tsconfig files as the context libs. Fails if the lib exists. Components, services and directives then come from ng-component, ng-service and ng-directive.
